measurement_method.source: DXF entity coordinates, no design_spec coordinates for overlap
measurement_method.grouping: Union each pocket with its own dogbones, then all pairs on each part and shared cut-depth interval
measurement_method.scope: A-side depth 10 mm in stock thickness 20 mm; not a full-thickness fracture finding

implementation_decisions.numeric_policy_scope: Apply from input resolution through all internal arithmetic, affine coordinate changes, Boolean geometry, pre-save validation, serialization, and readback; not only after DXF serialization.
implementation_decisions.comparison_policy: Use explicit unit-aware linear, area and ratio tolerances, valid geometry and intended feature/topology checks. Area difference alone is not a universal substitute for equals. Keep IDs, categories and counts exact.
implementation_decisions.precision_budget: Declare curve approximation and coordinate operation error bounds. Near-contact classification must include both shape approximation errors; numerical tolerances are not manufacturing fit allowances or minimum residual widths.
implementation_decisions.lap_opening_guard: Remove only in the same releasable change as rejection of unintended overlap/contact between parent machining features, with valid lap>opening and dense invalid controls together. Keep the current blind-seat lap<member-width rule.
implementation_decisions.unknown_manufacturing_threshold: Report measured gap/web values and PENDING. An unsupported provisional numeric warning must not imply manufacturing PASS.

acceptance_cases_for_implementation: Unchanged R2 baseline must pass regression before and after refactoring.
The enumerated valid decimal dimensions must pass both pre-save and saved-DXF checks after numeric policy implementation; this audit did not build all 200 packages.
463.4x585.4: normal derive succeeds; existing picture equals fails before save; two isolated area-comparison replacements permit 59 checks and validate-only.
463x586.4: normal derive succeeds; existing fixed-frame equals alone fails; one isolated area-comparison replacement permits 59 checks and validate-only.
Opening 30, lap 35, sash width 40, v=1: old lap bound rejects; removal permits 59 checks and no unintended parent-cut overlaps.
Same opening/lap/sash, v=2: removal alone permits 59 checks despite 4 J4/J4 overlaps. New geometry check must reject this within the same release.
Dense 12+4 must fail including all J4/J4 and J2/J4 connections, as recorded in prior evidence.
True picture margin and cutter/relief mismatches must remain rejected under normal and optimized Python after comparisons are made tolerant.

primary_sources.supports: equals tests spatial/topological equality and provides no distance tolerance argument.
equals_exact accepts a coordinate tolerance but requires matching coordinate/component order; not a blind drop-in for equals.
Decimal fractions and intermediate arithmetic can carry binary approximation errors; isclose and numeric representation must be chosen deliberately.

import difflib, hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
name = sys.argv[1]
folder = root / name / '02_cnc'
env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', PYTHONHASHSEED='0', PYTHONOPTIMIZE='0')
results = {'case': name, 'runs': []}

def run(label, command):
    started = time.monotonic()
    r = subprocess.run(command, cwd=folder, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
    row = {'label': label, 'returncode': r.returncode, 'seconds': time.monotonic()-started,
           'stdout': r.stdout, 'stderr': r.stderr}
    for filename in ('validation_report.json', 'validation_report_recheck.json'):
        q = folder / filename
        if r.returncode == 0 and q.is_file():
            j = json.loads(q.read_text())
            row[filename] = {k: j.get(k) for k in ('status', 'phase', 'checks_passed', 'saved_dxf_reread', 'sha256')}
    results['runs'].append(row)
    (root / (name+'_runs.json')).write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({'case':name, 'stage':label, 'exit':r.returncode, 'seconds':round(row['seconds'],2)}), flush=True)

run('original_full_cli', [sys.executable, 'build_portrait_double_leaf.py'])
if name == 'decimal_frame_463_586_4':
    target = folder / 'build_portrait_double_leaf.py'
    before = target.read_text()
    old = 'fixed.equals(box(0,0,W,H).difference(box(FW,FW,W-FW,H-FW)))'
    new = 'fixed.symmetric_difference(box(0,0,W,H).difference(box(FW,FW,W-FW,H-FW))).area < 1e-6'
elif name.startswith('decimal'):
    target = folder / 'build_portrait_double_leaf.py'
    before = target.read_text()
    old = 'pg.equals(box(PX+PMG,PY+PMG,PX+PMG+A3W,PY+PMG+A3H)) and rg.equals(box(PX,PY,PX+PRW,PY+PRH))'
    new = 'pg.symmetric_difference(box(PX+PMG,PY+PMG,PX+PMG+A3W,PY+PMG+A3H)).area < 1e-6 and rg.symmetric_difference(box(PX,PY,PX+PRW,PY+PRH)).area < 1e-6'
else:
    target = folder / 'generate_spec.py'
    before = target.read_text()
    old = "    assert lap <= v['open_w'] and lap <= v['open_h'], 'end lap longer than the opening'\n"
    new = ''
if before.count(old) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError('Unexpected baseline source; refuse patch')
after = before.replace(old, new)
target.write_text(after)
results['temporary_source_patch'] = {
    'file': target.name,
    'before_sha256': hashlib.sha256(before.encode()).hexdigest(),
    'after_sha256': hashlib.sha256(after.encode()).hexdigest(),
    'diff': ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(before.splitlines(True),after.splitlines(True),fromfile='baseline/'+target.name,tofile='temporary/'+target.name))
}
run('patched_full_cli_normal_assertions_active', [sys.executable, 'build_portrait_double_leaf.py'])
run('patched_validate_only', [sys.executable, 'build_portrait_double_leaf.py', '--validate-only'])

import collections, copy, hashlib, itertools, json, math, os, sys, traceback, types
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
base = Path('unified/02_cnc')
sys.path.insert(0, str(base))
import ezdxf, shapely
from shapely.geometry import box
from shapely.affinity import translate, affine_transform
from shapely.ops import unary_union
from cad_helpers import entity_polygon, meta
from generate_spec import derive

baseline = json.loads((base/'design_parameters.json').read_text())
source = (base/'build_portrait_double_leaf.py').read_text()
old = "PARAMS=json.loads((OUT/'design_parameters.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))"
if source.count(old) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError('Unexpected baseline input loading statement')
code = compile(source.replace(old, 'PARAMS=__probe_parameters__'), str(base/'build_portrait_double_leaf.py'), 'exec')
work = root/'sweep_work'
work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

class Captured(Exception):
    pass

def geometry_measurement(b, doc):
    ents = list(doc.modelspace())
    board = [e for e in ents if e.dxf.layer=='BOARD_BOUNDARY'][0]
    actual_board = entity_polygon(board)
    expected_board = box(0,0,b.BL,b.BWD)
    assembled = []
    for e in ents:
        if e.dxf.layer=='CUT_THROUGH' and meta(e)['part_id'].startswith('F'):
            q = meta(e)
            x,y = q['nesting_origin']
            assembled.append(affine_transform(translate(entity_polygon(e),-x,-y),q['assembly_map']))
    fixed = unary_union(assembled)
    expected_fixed = box(0,0,b.W,b.H).difference(box(b.FW,b.FW,b.W-b.FW,b.H-b.FW))
    items = {'board':(actual_board,expected_board), 'fixed_frame':(fixed,expected_fixed)}
    for e in ents:
        q=meta(e)
        if q.get('view')=='assembly' and q.get('role') in ('picture','picture_region'):
            g=translate(entity_polygon(e),-b.ASSEMBLY_ORIGIN[0],-b.ASSEMBLY_ORIGIN[1])
            expected = box(b.PX+b.PMG,b.PY+b.PMG,b.PX+b.PMG+b.A3W,b.PY+b.PMG+b.A3H) if q['role']=='picture' else box(b.PX,b.PY,b.PX+b.PRW,b.PY+b.PRH)
            items[q['role']]=(g,expected)
    return {k:{'equals':a.equals(e), 'symmetric_difference_area_mm2':a.symmetric_difference(e).area,
               'hausdorff_distance_mm':a.hausdorff_distance(e), 'actual_bounds':list(a.bounds),
               'expected_bounds':list(e.bounds)} for k,(a,e) in items.items()}

sweep = {'definition':{'width_mm':'463.1..473.0 in exact decimal 0.1 steps; height=586',
                      'height_mm':'586.1..596.0 in exact decimal 0.1 steps; width=463',
                      'picture':'Corresponding sheet dimension = outer dimension - 166, computed in Decimal before conversion to float',
                      'phase':'Full original validator on the generated in-memory DXF for every derive-success case; build intercepted immediately after pre-save validation',
                      'source_override':'Only PARAMS loading replaced in memory by the selected dict; output paths redirected to temporary work',
                      'optimization':sys.flags.optimize}, 'cases':[]}
for axis,start in [('width','463'),('height','586')]:
    for i in range(1,101):
        val=Decimal(start)+Decimal(i)/10
        p=copy.deepcopy(baseline)
        p['frame']['outer_'+axis]=float(val)
        p['picture']['sheet_'+axis]=float(val-166)
        row={'axis':axis,'outer_dimension_decimal':str(val),'picture_dimension_decimal':str(val-166),
             'outer_dimensions_mm':[p['frame']['outer_width'],p['frame']['outer_height']],
             'picture_dimensions_mm':[p['picture']['sheet_width'],p['picture']['sheet_height']]}
        try:
            derive(p)
        except AssertionError as exc:
            row.update(derive='FAIL',error=str(exc),source_line=traceback.extract_tb(exc.__traceback__)[-1].lineno)
            computed = p['frame']['outer_'+axis]-146
            expected = p['picture']['sheet_'+axis]+20
            row['relation_values_mm']=[computed,expected]
            row['relation_difference_mm']=computed-expected
        else:
            row['derive']='PASS'
            b=types.ModuleType('decimal_sweep_case')
            b.__file__=str(base/'build_portrait_double_leaf.py')
            b.__dict__['__probe_parameters__']=p
            exec(code,b.__dict__)
            b.OUT=work;b.SPEC=work/'design_spec.json';b.DXF=work/'never_saved.dxf'
            validate=b.validate
            def observe(doc,phase):
                row['phase']=phase
                row['exact_geometry_comparisons']=geometry_measurement(b,doc)
                try:
                    report=validate(doc,phase)
                    row['validator']={'status':'PASS','checks_passed':report['checks_passed']}
                except AssertionError as exc:
                    row['validator']={'status':'FAIL','failed_checks':str(exc).removeprefix('DXF validation failed: ').split(', ')}
                raise Captured()
            b.validate=observe
            try:
                b.build()
            except Captured:
                pass
        sweep['cases'].append(row)
    print(json.dumps({'completed_axis':axis,'cases':len(sweep['cases'])}),flush=True)

rows=sweep['cases']
sweep['summary']={
    'total_inputs':len(rows),
    'derive_failures':sum(r['derive']=='FAIL' for r in rows),
    'derive_failures_by_axis':dict(collections.Counter(r['axis'] for r in rows if r['derive']=='FAIL')),
    'pre_save_validator_inputs':sum(r['derive']=='PASS' for r in rows),

import ast, collections, hashlib, itertools, json, sys, types
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
base=Path('unified/02_cnc')
sys.path.insert(0,str(base))
import ezdxf
from shapely.geometry import box
from shapely.affinity import translate,affine_transform
from shapely.ops import unary_union
from cad_helpers import meta,entity_polygon

tree=ast.parse((root/'sweep_and_measure.py').read_text())
node=next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='geometry_measurement')
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node],type_ignores=[]),'geometry_measurement','exec'))
source=(base/'build_portrait_double_leaf.py').read_text()
params=json.loads((root/'decimal_463_4_585_4/02_cnc/design_parameters.json').read_text())
old="PARAMS=json.loads((OUT/'design_parameters.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))"
b=types.ModuleType('decimal_witness')
b.__file__=str(base/'build_portrait_double_leaf.py')
b.__dict__['__probe_parameters__']=params
exec(compile(source.replace(old,'PARAMS=__probe_parameters__'),b.__file__,'exec'),b.__dict__)
work=root/'decimal_memory_work';work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
b.OUT=work;b.SPEC=work/'design_spec.json';b.DXF=work/'never_saved.dxf'
result={'decimal_witness':{},'lap_controls':[]}
original=b.validate
class Captured(Exception):pass
def observe(doc,phase):
    row=result['decimal_witness']
    row['phase']=phase
    row['before_save_geometry']=geometry_measurement(b,doc)
    try:original(doc,phase)
    except AssertionError as exc:row['original_validator_error']=str(exc)
    raise Captured()
b.validate=observe
try:b.build()
except Captured:pass
dxf_name='hanok_window_A3_portrait_double_leaf_one_board_CNC.dxf'
result['decimal_witness']['patched_saved_geometry']=geometry_measurement(b,ezdxf.readfile(root/'decimal_463_4_585_4/02_cnc'/dxf_name))

for name in ['lap35_open30_v1_s40','lap35_open30_v2_s40']:
    folder=root/name/'02_cnc'
    doc=ezdxf.readfile(folder/dxf_name)
    cuts={};dogs=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for e in doc.modelspace():
        q=meta(e)
        if q.get('kind')=='pocket':cuts[q['feature_id']]={'meta':q,'geometry':entity_polygon(e)}
        elif q.get('kind')=='dogbone':dogs[q['parent_pocket']].append(entity_polygon(e))
    groups=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for fid,cut in cuts.items():
        cut['geometry']=unary_union([cut['geometry']]+dogs[fid])
        groups[(cut['meta']['part_id'],cut['meta']['machining_face'])].append((fid,cut))
    overlaps=[];contacts=[];distances=[]
    for (pid,face),features in groups.items():
        for (aid,a),(bid,c) in itertools.combinations(features,2):
            if face!='A' or a['meta']['depth_mm']!=10 or c['meta']['depth_mm']!=10:
                raise RuntimeError('This probe only classifies common A-side 10 mm cuts')
            ga,gc=a['geometry'],c['geometry']
            dist=ga.distance(gc);area=ga.intersection(gc).area
            distances.append(dist)
            row={'part_id':pid,'machining_face':face,'shared_cut_depth_mm':10,'features':[aid,bid],
                 'joint_types':[a['meta']['joint'],c['meta']['joint']], 'overlap_area_mm2':area,'distance_mm':dist}
            if area>1e-7:overlaps.append(row)
            elif dist<=1e-6:contacts.append(row)
    spec=json.loads((folder/'design_spec.json').read_text())
    params=json.loads((folder/'design_parameters.json').read_text())
    from generate_spec import derive
    # Derived dimensions are read from the valid spec where the one guard is removed;
    # counts and overlaps are measured above from actual saved DXF entities.
    opening=30;nv=params['lattice']['vertical_per_leaf'];bw=params['lattice']['bar_width']
    result['lap_controls'].append({'case':name,'parameter_changes':{
        'frame.outer_width':309,'leaf.member_width':40,'lattice.end_lap_length':35,
        'lattice.vertical_per_leaf':nv,'picture.sheet_width':123,'picture.sheet_height':400},
        'nominal_cell_gap_mm':(opening-nv*bw)/(nv+1),'parent_feature_count':len(cuts),
        'same_part_same_face_pair_count':len(distances),'minimum_distance_mm':min(distances),
        'overlap_count':len(overlaps),'contact_without_positive_area_count':len(contacts),
        'overlapping_pairs':overlaps,'contacts':contacts,
        'dxf_sha256':hashlib.sha256((folder/dxf_name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
result['measurement_method']={'source':'DXF entity coordinates, no design_spec coordinates for overlap',
    'grouping':'Union each pocket with its own dogbones, then all pairs on each part and shared cut-depth interval',
    'arc_flattening_mm':1e-5,'overlap_area_classification_mm2':1e-7,'contact_distance_classification_mm':1e-6,
    'scope':'A-side depth 10 mm in stock thickness 20 mm; not a full-thickness fracture finding'}
(root/'control_geometry.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
